# arch-viewer Documentation

This directory contains generated architecture diagrams and documentation.

## Generated Files

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| `architecture-interactive.html` | Interactive architecture diagram (auto-generated by `diagram_generator.py`) |

## Generating Diagrams

Diagrams are produced automatically when arch-viewer scans a project.
You can also trigger generation manually via the MCP tool:

```
generate_interactive_diagram
```

Or from the dashboard at http://localhost:3777 by clicking **Generate Diagram**
in the toolbar.
